title: Q12
description:
Read: Lev 16:6, Lev 16:11, Lev 21:10-15

He offers for himself first. He must not defile himself for the dead, and he must not profane his seed.

a) Holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and not offering daily for his own sins: which obligations fall away, and which priestly nearness remains?
